target: Identify whether the prospectively selected future obligation distinguishes source facts whose revision paths q merged, without any arm, Gamma, Phi_path, reachability, or downstream-outcome input.

formal_object.T_future: For frozen current witness w_f, T_future(f) is the canonical semantic JSON-tree delta from w_f to the configuration produced by the selected future Biome release's own migrate --write operation on w_f.
formal_object.J_future: For a frozen grounding pair (f_i,f_j): DISTINGUISHED iff both T_future signatures are identified and unequal; EQUIVALENT iff both are identified and equal; NOT_IDENTIFIED otherwise.
formal_object.kernel_test: kernel(q) subset kernel(T_future) iff no identified q-kernel grounding unit is DISTINGUISHED and there is no NOT_IDENTIFIED unit preventing the requested inclusion claim. A DISTINGUISHED grounding unit is a direct non-inclusion witness.

external_consequence_contract.future_release_identity: the single event selected by the frozen predicate-G first-qualifying rule
external_consequence_contract.execution_location: global treatment-blind grounding stage outside both arms
inputs: selected future Biome release executable from the common obligation bundle
external_consequence_contract.per_witness_invocation: place exactly one frozen witness at biome.json in an isolated empty working directory and invoke the selected release's migrate --write operation under the frozen common environment
successful_identification_requires: both repeated invocations complete under the same logical execution contract
both produced biome.json files strict-JSON parse successfully
the two canonical future outputs are identical
the two canonical delta signatures are identical

delta_semantics.mapping_delta: recursively emit ADD/REMOVE/REPLACE operations over sorted JSON-pointer paths
delta_semantics.array_delta: if unequal, REPLACE the array value at its JSON-pointer path
delta_semantics.canonical_signature: canonical JSON serialization of the ordered delta operation list
delta_semantics.rationale: No future field is hand-labelled as relevant or irrelevant. The selected release's observable migration consequence on each frozen current witness defines T_future.

coverage.missing_unit: retain row as NOT_IDENTIFIED; never drop it
coverage.relation_kind_lift: Each source-fact grounding status is lifted deterministically to all four pre-frozen q-kernel relation-kind surfaces. These surfaces are not independent grounding observations.

independence.domain_origin: The grounding domain is derived once from q before future disclosure. J_future receives the frozen domain, not Gamma at runtime.
independence.future_event_selection: inherited from G; J_future cannot choose or replace the selected release

status_semantics.DISTINGUISHED: the future migration consequence signatures differ
status_semantics.EQUIVALENT: the future migration consequence signatures are exactly equal
status_semantics.NOT_IDENTIFIED: at least one consequence signature is not identified; distinct from EQUIVALENT and never imputed

postgate_link.rule: Only after J_future grounds a unit as DISTINGUISHED may the reference-based post-gate algebra ask whether the corresponding relation-kind COMPARE probe remains reachable under Gamma.

attack_requirements: runtime grounding functions have no forbidden treatment inputs
frozen domain exactly covers all q-kernel path surfaces and no favorable subset
all six B-manifest witnesses are present exactly once
JSON representation rewrites leave T_future and J_future unchanged
parse failure, execution failure, or nondeterministic repeats produce NOT_IDENTIFIED
relation-kind lifts inherit the grounding-unit status without creating extra independent evidence
